formal_rules: Freeze complete epochs from actual TRAIN time/memory, never from validation/test score.
Each of45 positions is a fresh fit; old results cannot fill new cases.
Single task/seed models and TRAIN statistics are independent; no cross-task warm start.
Readout, language generation and same-checkpoint C1 are separately scored.
Malformed generation stays in full test denominator; never repair with readout.
Keep all registered seeds despite neutral/negative early gains.
M0 andM3 match active parameters andcommunication within task/backbone; ESM capacity and FLOPs reported separately.
No fourth physical GPU and no scheduled app monitor; preserve old jobs/results.
All tasks remain fixed benchmarks with existing historical exposure; no claim of unseen pretraining data.

budget_evidence.basis: actual TRAIN time/memory only; no validation/test scores read
budget_evidence.reason: Representative actual TRAIN-only qualifiers completed4updates16examples for each task. Shared-node steady update rates were approximately1.27s for Meltome,1.07s for ELM and0.99s for RT on1.5B. Across45 fresh fits, two Qwen backbones and full language evaluation, three complete common epochs provide a practical first comparison while preserving all three seeds and complete frozen splits. FourB performs its separate technical TRAIN qualification before each fresh formal fit when actual memory is available. No validation or test score was consulted. No score-based early stopping or changes to parsing, metrics, source labels or selection rules.
budget_evidence.qwen3_qualification: performed when actual18GiB+headroom becomes available; common epochs already fixed, never changed by score
